text: Embeddings are numerical representations of text.
Machine learning models cannot directly understand text, so text is converted into vectors.
Sentence Transformers are commonly used to generate embeddings.
Similar pieces of text produce embeddings that are close together in vector space.
Embeddings are the foundation of semantic search and RAG applications.

FAISS stands for Facebook AI Similarity Search.
FAISS is a vector database used for similarity search.
It stores embeddings and helps retrieve the most relevant information based on vector distance.
FAISS is commonly used in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.
When a user asks a question, FAISS compares the question embedding with stored document embeddings and returns the nearest matches.
RAG has two main steps: ingestion and retrieval.
In ingestion, documents are loaded, split into chunks, converted into embeddings, and stored in a vector database.
In retrieval, the user question is converted into an embedding, compared with stored document embeddings, and the most relevant chunks are returned.
